title: Button "Setup a NAP network" in bluetooth connection settings does nothing.
line: The Bluetooth device page now shows "Setup NAP Network…" when the phone has no network connection yet, and clicking it creates one.
explanation: The KCM asks plasma-nm whether a Bluetooth network connection already exists for the device and used the answer as "show the button". So the Setup NAP/DUN buttons appeared only when a connection was already there, and plasma-nm's addBluetoothConnection then returns early because it exists: the click silently does nothing, while devices without a connection never got the button. The change inverts the check so the buttons show only when no connection exists yet and the device is connected.

commits.message:
kcm: Show network setup buttons only when there's no connection yet

The "Setup NAP Network…" and "Setup DUN Network…" buttons appeared
only when the device already had a network connection, where clicking
does nothing. Show them when no connection exists, so they can set it up.

BUG: 441665

patches.diff:
From 551c5a9eb9cd2821ebe0517feeca90dab91bd9ea Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 15:18:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] kcm: Show network setup buttons only when there's no
 connection yet
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The "Setup NAP Network…" and "Setup DUN Network…" buttons appeared
only when the device already had a network connection, where clicking
does nothing. Show them when no connection exists, so they can set it up.

BUG: 441665
---
 src/kcm/ui/Device.qml | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/kcm/ui/Device.qml b/src/kcm/ui/Device.qml
index 85814855..6a1d59e5 100644
--- a/src/kcm/ui/Device.qml
+++ b/src/kcm/ui/Device.qml
@@ -55,10 +55,10 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
         function onNetworkAvailable(service: string, available: bool): void {
             switch (service) {
             case "dun":
-                dunButton.visible = available && root.device.connected;
+                dunButton.visible = !available && root.device.connected;
                 break;
             case "nap":
-                napButton.visible = available && root.device.connected;
+                napButton.visible = !available && root.device.connected;
                 break;
             default:
                 break;
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master, phone offering NAP with no network connection yet: no Setup NAP Network button.
Master, once a NAP connection exists the button appears; clicking it does nothing (no new connection, no dialog).
With the fix, no connection yet: the Setup NAP Network button is shown; clicking it creates the connection in NetworkManager.
With the fix, after the connection exists: the button is gone.
